privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: How the hostel uses your information.
privacy.required: Please read and accept the privacy notice to continue using the portal.
privacy.accepted: Thank you. Your consent has been recorded.

default.lead: The hostel office uses this portal to manage hostel admission, rooms, fees, the mess, leave, grievances and certificates. This notice explains what personal data is used and why, as required by the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
default.collect: Your name, register number, programme, contact details, address, emergency contact, parent or guardian details, room allotment, fee and payment records, mess attendance, leave and grievance records. Card and UPI details are handled by the payment gateway and never stored by the portal.
default.use: Only to run the hostel: allot rooms, collect fees, bill the mess, approve leave, resolve grievances, issue certificates and send you and your parents updates by SMS, WhatsApp or email.
default.share: Authorised hostel staff for their duties, your linked parents or guardians, and HyFib Solutions Private Limited, which operates the portal on the institution's behalf. Data is not sold or used for advertising.
default.keep: For as long as you stay in the hostel and afterwards for the period required by the institution's rules and the law. Data is stored in India and protected with encryption.
default.rights: You may ask to see, correct or erase your data, withdraw consent where the law allows, and raise a grievance about how it is handled.
default.contact: Contact the hostel office for any privacy request. Questions about the portal itself can go to HyFib support, listed on the Help page.

help.title: Help and support
help.intro: Who to contact, and answers to common questions.
help.hostelOfficeBody: Rooms, fees, records and anything about hostel rules.
help.portalSupportBody: Sign-in problems, payment errors or anything not working in this portal. Available 24×7.
help.hostelIssuesBody: For repairs, cleanliness, food, safety or staff issues, raise a grievance so the warden can track it.
help.ticket1: Give your register number (or your ward's) and the mobile number you sign in with.
help.ticket2: Say what you were trying to do and what you saw, for example an error message.
help.ticket3: For payments, keep the Razorpay or bank reference number handy.
help.neverShare: Never share your sign-in code with anyone. Hostel and HyFib staff will never ask for it.

otp.q: I didn't receive the sign-in code.
otp.a: Wait a minute, then tap Resend. Try WhatsApp instead of SMS, check that the number is the one registered with the hostel office, and make sure your phone has signal. Codes are valid for five minutes.

wrongNumber.a: Ask the hostel office to update the number on your record. For your security it can't be changed from the portal.

payment.q: Money was debited but no receipt appeared.
payment.a: Payments are confirmed with the bank automatically, usually within 15 minutes. If the receipt still hasn't appeared after an hour, contact portal support with the payment reference.

receipt.q: Where do I find my receipts?
receipt.a: Open Fees and tap Receipts. Every payment, online or at the office, has a downloadable PDF receipt.

leave.a: After you apply, your parent approves the request (if the hostel requires it), then the warden. You are notified at each step and can follow progress on the Leave page.

confidential.a: Hostel staff handling it. Confidential grievances, and all ragging or harassment complaints, are visible only to the warden.

language.q: Can I use the portal in Tamil?
language.a: Yes. Choose தமிழ் from the language switch on the sign-in page, the More page or your Profile.
